title: Shivaji Surathkal
desc: Shivaji, a policeman, sets out to investigate a high-profile murder of a minister's son. However, while pursuing the leads, he must also deal with his own wife's death.

title: Shakti: The Power
desc: Nandini and Shekhar's visit to India turns tragic when they meet his violent family. After losing Shekhar, Nandini fights to save their son and escape back home.

title: Arjun
desc: Arjun steps in to protect his twin sister when her in-laws attempt to kill her.

title: Boss
desc: Ram and Raj are estranged twins. When Raj learns that Ram has been mysteriously murdered, he sets out to avenge his death.

title: Kishkindhapuri
desc: The guests visit a vintage radio station for a ghost tour where they awaken a slumbering spirit. Locked inside, they struggle to escape as otherworldly powers endanger their existence.

title: G.O.A.T
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.
